places.name: Mara's Hut
places.description: The only house in town: a low timber hut where Mara lives, with Finn lodging in the back room. The big tree stands right beside it.

places.name: The Forge
places.description: Mara's open-air blacksmith forge under the big tree beside her hut, inherited from her mother. A stone hearth, an anvil, and racks of horseshoes, hinges, and tools for sale. The ring of the hammer carries across town from sunrise to dusk.

places.name: The Meadow
places.description: Open grassland where Finn forages herbs, mushrooms, and wild berries. No trees or buildings, just long grass and wildflowers, and travelers crossing town often cut through it.
